title: Validate AI-era reference-model companies
rawUserRequest: 目标不是继续优化 Ranking，而是找出 AI 时代改变组织结构、重写生产系统、产生持续结果并被行业模仿的公司，成为类似电力时代通用电气的行业范本。用户确认以组织重写、生产系统重写、持续结果、行业扩散四类证据作为每个阶段的硬性验收标准，并要求本轮收掉目标链路上的历史债务；发现问题就在当前 WI 内修复，直到没有问题为止。Python 和 Shell 只用于可复现采集、调用、测试和 CI，不承载领域判断。

problemStatement: ORG-X currently distinguishes source availability, document discovery, validated facts, and structural evidence, but it has no governed evidence bundle that can prove or reject the stronger research claim that one company became an AI-era industry reference model. Organization announcements can therefore stop at a production-system candidate without explicitly binding sustained operating outcomes, independent diffusion, counter evidence, and missing proof into one fail-closed decision. The preceding SEC/IR discovery Work Item is archived on this base; this Work Item consumes that bounded acquisition capability and adds the reference-model decision boundary.

Hosted CI, PR creation, merge, release, and Work Item closure; the requested stopping condition is local problem resolution and evidence-backed handoff

riskAssessment.reason: This Work Item adds the strongest research claim in the product. A false positive would label a company an industry exemplar without production results or imitation; a false negative could hide a valid candidate. The gate must therefore require four distinct evidence families, explicit source authority, multiple outcome periods, independent diffusion, counter evidence, missing-proof accounting, cutoff dates, deterministic ordering, and legacy-compatible serialization. Unknown external research results are verification outcomes, not implementation permission gaps.
riskAssessment.reviewedBy: User approved the four-family hard acceptance boundary and requested iteration until in-scope problems are resolved.

reasons: The Work Item changes the highest transformation-stage gate, the judgment read model, serialized report output, and evidence-family semantics.

executionDecision.reason: The four evidence families, fail-closed promotion gate, user-visible output, TDD scenarios, and local verification boundary are explicit. No unresolved design unknown blocks implementation.

preReviewWarnings: Do not promote a company from organization rewrite to reference model without a distinct production-system claim, two dated outcome observations, and independent diffusion evidence.
Do not infer diffusion from the candidate company describing its own framework; diffusion requires independent peer or industry adoption evidence with named adopters and source provenance.
Do not treat missing data or an unavailable source as counter evidence; preserve UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, MissingProof, and CounterEvidence separately.
Do not implement the gate in Python or Shell. Those tools may invoke fixtures and the Rust binary, while domain classification and eligibility remain in Rust.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Each hard-gate phase must leave an auditable RED/GREEN checkpoint and cannot be declared complete from self-report.

acceptance: A provider-neutral ReferenceModelEvidenceFamily enum distinguishes OrganizationRewrite, ProductionSystemRewrite, SustainedOutcome, and IndustryDiffusion without allowing a source observation or page-level fact to satisfy a family.
Validated evidence carries an optional family classification and provenance; legacy NormalizedFact and RuntimeReportInput JSON without the field remain readable with a safe default.

A reference-model assessment is Candidate only when organization rewrite and production-system rewrite evidence exist but one or more outcome, diffusion, counter-review, or missing-proof conditions remain open.

A reference-model assessment is Confirmed only when all four evidence families are present, sustained outcome evidence contains at least two distinct effective periods, diffusion contains at least two independent source URIs and named adopters or peers, all critical sources are authoritative, and counter evidence review has been represented.
A missing or degraded source never satisfies a required family and never becomes a negative claim; the assessment exposes MissingProof and data-degraded state explicitly.
A generic engineering article, product launch, hiring page, layoff, or self-described AI strategy cannot become a Confirmed reference model without the complete four-family bundle.

The highest REFERENCE_MODEL Stage gate uses the reference-model eligibility decision and cannot be satisfied by generic judgment facts alone; lower Stage and existing Ranking ordering remain unchanged.

The report adds a localized AI-era reference-model validation section showing Candidate, Confirmed, or NotEligible status plus supporting families, counter evidence, and missing proof; it never labels Candidate as an industry exemplar.
The report preserves the prior separation between validated facts, structural evidence, source availability, pending leads, and unavailable facts, including calibrated no-change wording.

TDD fixtures cover complete confirmed bundle, missing outcome, missing diffusion, self-description-only, duplicate source identity, future cutoff, degraded source, counter evidence, legacy deserialization, and localized rendering.
A live or deterministic registry run emits an evidence matrix for every configured company and identifies the strongest candidate without fabricating a Confirmed exemplar when the gate is incomplete.

The configured candidate research entrypoints include bounded official sources for organization/production-system claims and independent named-peer diffusion cases, while preserving the existing SEC/IR and source-status boundaries.
Python/Shell entrypoints remain orchestration-only; Rust owns family classification, gate evaluation, Stage suppression, serialization, and report values.

Before Finish, `make check-ai-knowledge`, `make check-ai-status-consistency`, `make check-ai-scope CONTRACT=.ai/work-items/active/wi-weekly-radar-reference-model-evidence.contract.json`, `git diff --check`, and the declared quality commands pass; `make check-ai-knowledge` reports a valid index, status consistency reports no unowned paths, and the final report has separate labels for validated facts, structural evidence, source availability, pending leads, unavailable facts, and reference-model status.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.
Keep provider-specific parsing outside the domain and keep the reference-model gate provider-neutral and deterministic.
Use typed evidence families and explicit provenance instead of inferring eligibility from arbitrary text or scores.
Prefer false negatives to promoting an organization announcement, marketing claim, or page-level observation as a reference model.
Require at least two distinct dated outcome periods and independent diffusion sources; a single source or single period is insufficient.
Preserve UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, CounterEvidence, and MissingProof as different states.
Use Python and Shell only for bounded orchestration, fixtures, and verification; do not place business judgment in scripts.
Preserve legacy snapshot deserialization and localized semantic-splitter compatibility.
Resolve in-scope defects in this Work Item; do not create another Work Item merely to avoid a failing hard gate.

intent.problem: The current evidence chain can identify organization or production-system signals, but it cannot answer the product's actual question: which company changed its organization and production system, achieved persistent operating results, and became a model others adopted. Without a typed four-family bundle, a company can be described as an AI transformation candidate but cannot be rigorously promoted or rejected as a reference model.
constraints: The reference-model decision must be deterministic, fail-closed, provider-neutral, cutoff-aware, and independent of Ranking scores.
Organization rewrite is necessary but insufficient; outcome persistence and independent diffusion are mandatory.
Counter evidence and missing proof must remain explicit and cannot be collapsed into a confidence score.
Python and Shell may orchestrate bounded runs and verification but may not own domain judgment.
The prior bounded SEC/IR acquisition implementation and its archived evidence are immutable inputs to this Work Item.
intent.rationale: The highest-value remaining gap is not another provider or another ranking heuristic. It is a single auditable decision boundary that joins the four evidence families and prevents a compelling organization story from being mistaken for a proven industry paradigm.
